mechanisms.name: PERSISTENCE_BACKPRESSURE
mechanisms.evidence: Last observed outstanding budget was 243200 of 256000; empty/drained canonical queue does not release durability budget. Synthetic sustained slow-writer scenarios reach the exact fence even with queue high-water 1.
mechanisms.limitation: No historical terminal enum or event-time budget snapshot; proximity to the cap cannot prove causality.

mechanisms.name: CATALOG_COMMIT_BEFORE_COMPLETION_OBSERVATION
mechanisms.evidence: Accepted writer append runs on persistence executor; durable state changes in a separate completion task. One authenticated 80000-frame unit exists beyond the last telemetry durable value. Synthetic delayed callback reproduces this ordering.
mechanisms.limitation: Historical append/completion timestamps are absent; exact ordering at failure is unknown.

mechanisms.name: CORRUPTED_COMMITTED_PREFIX
mechanisms.evidence: All 388 committed units authenticate with contiguous source ranges through frame 31040000.
mechanisms.limitation: Does not prove safety or existence of an uncommitted tail.

mechanisms.name: STORAGE_FAILURE_AUTHORITY_REVOCATION_LIFECYCLE_OEM_HOST_OR_WRITER_FAILURE
mechanisms.evidence: Historical receipt lacks the exact terminal path. No positive attribution is supported.
mechanisms.limitation: Bounded log absence of fatal/ANR messages is not proof that these causes did not occur.
